findings.title: Feature-gated dashboard tables discard the query result
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and a hard-coded empty `tableData` instead of the current `result.data`, `result.meta`, and widget field configuration. Consequently every table widget for enabled organizations renders an empty table with no headers or rows, even though the query completed successfully. Pass the actual table result and derived columns/renderers into the new visualization before enabling this path.

findings.title: Attribute-key query cache key is not scoped to the organization
findings.body: The React Query key contains only the date/project/type query options and omits `organization.slug`, whereas the request made by `useGetTraceItemAttributeKeys` is organization-scoped. In particular, an all-project query has no project IDs and will readily collide when navigating between organizations with the same time range. The hook also deliberately returns the previous data while a fetch is in progress, so keys from the prior organization can be displayed in the next organization's Explore UI. Include the organization slug (or endpoint path) in `queryKey` to prevent cross-organization cache reuse.

findings.title: Browser report age accepts invalid negative values and zero-valued mixed fields
findings.body: `age` has no non-negative constraint even though the Reporting API age is an elapsed duration, so reports with a negative age are accepted. In addition, the mutual-exclusion checks at lines 52 and 58 use truthiness; a report containing both `age: 0` and `timestamp: 0` passes validation even though the endpoint intends these alternative-format fields to be mutually exclusive. Validate field presence rather than truthiness and set `min_value=0` for `age`.
